prerequisites: General chemistry knowledge. Reviewing a high school chemistry textbook is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Enable students to identify, formulate, and solve problems related to matter structure, chemical bonding, and inorganic compound nomenclature.
Enable students to understand, identify, and solve aspects related to states of aggregation of matter, solutions, thermodynamic and kinetic concepts, and chemical equilibrium.
Enable students to acquire the ability to understand the scientific fundamentals of chemistry and apply them in the field of engineering.
Students should be able to gather and interpret relevant data (usually within their field of study) to make judgments that include reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.
Basic knowledge of general chemistry, organic and inorganic chemistry, and their applications in engineering.

syllabus_topics: Inorganic and organic substances of industrial interest.
